title: PGDM in Big Data Analytics: subjects and credit system
content:
AIDTM uses a credit system: one credit equals 10 in-class contact hours. A 3-credit course involves around 100 hours of effort, of which 30 hours are in the classroom and the rest is for assignments, preparation and learning beyond the classroom.
### Subjects (PGDM in Big Data Analytics)
Data Analysis using SQL
Enterprise Data Visualisation
Express, Impress, Managers Impact
HR Analytics
Fundamentals of Finance
Introduction to Big Data Analytics
Statistical Learning
Introduction to Machine Learning
Professional Communicative English
Marketing Management
Python for Data Science
Deep Learning
Statistics for Data Analytics using Excel
Image Processing using Python
Cloud Computing
Analytical Insights into Networking, Cyber Security, and Fraud Detection
Data Exploration & Visualisation using Python
NoSQL Database
The Apply Admission page also lists "Data Driven Decision Making" among the course curriculum highlights for this programme.

title: EPAAA: tools, curriculum modules and learning outcomes
content:
### Tools & Techniques Covered
Microsoft Excel: analysis, modelling and reporting for business analytics and decision support.
Power BI: business intelligence and data visualization, turning raw data into interactive dashboards and reports.
Power Apps: a low-code platform to build and deploy custom enterprise applications.
Power Automate: workflow automation across business processes.
AI Builder: adds AI features such as prediction, form processing and text recognition to low-code applications and workflows.
Microsoft Copilot: generative AI assistance for reporting, analysis, forecasting and decision support.
### The Curriculum
Key modules: Decision Science & Analytics Thinking; Forecasting & Operational Excellence; Power BI for Decision Intelligence; AI for Enterprise; Power Apps - Low-Code Enterprise Solutions; Power Automate & Workflow Engineering; AI Builder & Intelligent Automation.
### Learning Outcomes
Analyze business problems and evaluate decision alternatives using data-driven frameworks; apply statistical methods and forecasting models; design KPI frameworks aligned with business objectives; build interactive dashboards; apply no-code AI tools to business problems; evaluate process optimization opportunities; build and deploy low-code business applications; design automated workflows; integrate AI capabilities into applications and workflows; explain and evaluate ethical, governance and risk considerations in AI deployment.
